HEXTALE PLAYTEST AGREEMENT AND TERMS OF USE

Last updated: 16/09/2026

By selecting “I Agree”, you agree to the following terms and confirm that you have read how we handle your data (sections 11 to 13).

1. About Hextale

Hextale is an independent game project run by two individual developers. It is not a registered company.

Contact: support@hextalegame.com

2. Eligibility

Hextale is for users aged 13 or older. If the law of your country requires a parent's or legal guardian's permission for you to use a service like this, you must have it.

By using Hextale, you confirm that you meet these requirements.

3. Playtest Purpose

You are being given access to a pre-release version of Hextale for testing and evaluation purposes.

Playtest versions are experimental and may contain bugs, incomplete features and temporary content. Progress, cards, accounts, rankings, rewards and other game data may be changed, reset or removed during or after the playtest. Taking part in the playtest does not guarantee continued access to Hextale.

4. No Copying or Imitation

You agree not to use anything you learn, see, or experience through the Hextale playtest to:

  • copy or recreate Hextale;
  • imitate Hextale or its distinctive combination of original elements;
  • create a game or product that is substantially derived from Hextale; or
  • assist anyone else in doing any of the above.

This applies to Hextale's original game design, systems, mechanics, rules, cards, abilities, characters, artwork, lore, content, and other distinctive elements learned through the playtest.

5. Independent Development

Nothing in this Agreement prevents you from creating or working on your own games or products independently.

You may use general game-development knowledge, skills, and ideas that you developed independently and without using Hextale as the basis for your work.

6. Intellectual Property

Hextale and all of its intellectual property remain the property of Hextale or its respective licensors. This includes its software, game design, artwork, characters as represented in Hextale, user interface, logos, text and audio.

Your participation in the playtest does not grant you any ownership or rights in Hextale.

7. Your Account

You can create an account with an email address and password, or with Google. You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure and for all activity on your account.

You must not:

  • use false or misleading information, or impersonate another person;
  • share your account credentials;
  • try to access another user's account.

We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms or put the security of the game at risk.

8. Fair Play

You must not:

  • cheat, exploit bugs or manipulate the game;
  • use bots, scripts, automation or other unauthorized tools;
  • reverse engineer, attack or disrupt the game or its servers;
  • interfere with other players' experience;
  • abuse the reporting or support systems.
9. Virtual Items and Donations

Cards, currencies, rewards and other virtual items are part of the game. They are not your property and have no value outside Hextale. They cannot be sold, exchanged or redeemed for real money. We may change them as the game develops.

Donations are voluntary and are processed by PayPal. We do not receive your payment card details.

10. Feedback

By sending us feedback, suggestions or bug reports, you allow us to use them freely to develop Hextale, at no cost and without asking further permission. You keep ownership of any original intellectual property in your feedback.

11. Your Data

We collect:

  • Account: email address; password (stored only in hashed form); player name; email verification status; account creation and modification dates. If you use Google: your Google account identifier and email address, and possibly your Google name and profile image.
  • Game: acceptance of this Agreement (version, date and time); collection, decks, progression and season data; online status.
  • Telemetry, linked to your player ID:
    • session duration and time spent on each screen;
    • for each match: players involved, start and end times, duration, winner, decks used, cards drawn, moves, conquests and points.
  • Reports: the reporting player, the reported player, their player names, and the content of the report.

We do not ask for your date of birth, age, country, phone number or payment card details.

We use this data to:

  • run your account and the game;
  • protect accounts and prevent cheating and abuse;
  • investigate reports;
  • fix bugs, balance and improve Hextale.

Our legal bases are the performance of this agreement, our legitimate interests (security, fair play, game development), and legal obligations where they apply.

Hextale does not use third-party analytics or advertising trackers. Telemetry runs on our own servers and is never used for advertising.

Where your data is stored. Our game servers (Nakama with a PostgreSQL database) run on a virtual server provided by Cloudzy and located in Switzerland. The European Commission recognizes Switzerland as offering an adequate level of data protection.

Other service providers.

  • Google, for sign-in;
  • PayPal, for donations;
  • Cloudflare, for game downloads and updates.

Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, with the safeguards required by law.

Retention. We keep account data while your account is active. When you delete your account, your profile, collection, decks and account are erased. Gameplay telemetry, match records and player reports may be kept for up to 12 months after deletion, for security, abuse prevention and game development, or longer where the law requires it.

12. Your Rights

Under the GDPR, you can:

  • access or correct your data;
  • ask us to delete or restrict it;
  • object to certain processing, or ask for data portability;
  • lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.

You can delete your account at any time from the game settings. For any other request, write to support@hextalegame.com. We may need to verify your identity first.

13. “Remember me”

The “Remember me” option on the login screen is off by default. If you turn it on, the game saves one entry on your device, in the local storage of the app or browser: hextale.ricordami.

It contains only your email address and a renewal token that keeps you logged in. It is deleted when you select “Disconnect” or delete your account. The desktop app also keeps the email address you last used to log in, so the login form is pre-filled. The game uses no other cookies or local storage.

14. Availability and Liability

Hextale is provided “as is” and “as available”. We may change, suspend or discontinue all or part of it at any time, and we do not guarantee it will be uninterrupted or error-free.

To the extent permitted by law, the developers are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from your use of Hextale. Nothing in this Agreement limits rights that cannot be limited by law, including your rights as a consumer.

15. Changes

We may update this Agreement. When we make important changes, we will ask you to review and accept the new version in the game.

16. Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by Italian law. This does not affect any mandatory consumer protection rights in your country of residence.

17. Acceptance

By selecting “I Agree”, you confirm that:

  • you have read and understood this Agreement;
  • you agree to be bound by its terms;
  • you agree not to copy, recreate, or substantially imitate Hextale based on your participation in the playtest; and
  • you have read how your data is handled in sections 11 to 13.

The full Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy are available at hextalegame.com.

Disclaimer

No AI policy

We do not believe AI should be considered a replacement for human-made art, nor do we consider AI-generated imagery to be a substitute for the work of real artists.

This build of Hextale is a work-in-progress prototype, created solely for testing, experimentation, and sharing the development of this passion project.

At launch, all AI-generated artwork currently present in the game will be replaced with original artwork created by real artists.

No Pay-to-win policy

Hextale is, and will always be, a strictly no-pay-to-win game.

Cards level up simply by playing the game. Card packs can only be obtained through gameplay or by spending non-premium currency.

Non-premium currency can only be earned by playing.

Premium currency will be used exclusively for cosmetics and for optional early access to new cards. It will never give players a competitive advantage.

Progress will be wiped

Please note that all player progress from the current prototype and playtest phase will be wiped before the official launch.

This version of Hextale is a work-in-progress prototype created solely to showcase the game, test its systems, gather feedback, and continuously improve it as we work towards the Alpha stage.

Because the game is still under active development, progression, cards, currencies, and other player data may change significantly along the way.
